in_marathi.name: Sharvanshk
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sharvanshk हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Sharvanshk is a name derived from the Sanskrit word 'sharvan', meaning 'hearing'. The suffix 'shk' is a modern addition and is believed to represent the idea of creation and God's manifestation in the world. Thus, Sharvanshk can be interpreted as 'God's creation'.
